phase_metrics.scope: real physical cohorts; initialization excluded; not an exclusive hardware attribution
real physical cohorts; initialization excluded; not an exclusive hardware attribution

storage_traffic.queue_depth_scope: max across physical owners: outstanding page commands per host channel sampled at admission, including the admitted command

hbf0.memory: outstanding page commands per host channel sampled at admission, including the admitted command

storage_traffic.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage_traffic.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

dram_traffic.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.
dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

metadata.geometry_basis: FlashLabAE 16 channels * 1 die/channel * 16 banks/die; target and LUN are singleton mapping levels
metadata.timing_basis: 4 us read, 75 us program and 2 ms erase are upstream exploratory assumptions, not OCP mandated latencies
metadata.model_scope: Research adaptation, not a complete FlashLabAE reproduction, UCIe/AXI implementation or calibrated HBF device
metadata.protocol_basis: OCP HBF v0.7.0 full-page writes, sequential block programming, page-0 erase, 64-byte reads and host-channel admission
metadata.parallelism_mapping: Independent bank resources derived from geometry; parallel_units override forbidden in OCP mode
metadata.queue_basis: 256 combined requests and 64 writes per host channel are local research assumptions; not a measured MOCS or an exact copy of upstream read/write queues
metadata.internal_transfer_basis: 96 GB/s payload per core channel = upstream 101.25 GB/s raw * 4096/(4096+224 OOB); no separate OOB/ECC/TSV stages

host_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Grade-2 interface payload budget: 16 channels * x64 * 16 GT/s / 8 * 75% = 1536 GB/s per direction. Program latency separately limits media writes; no extra 16 GB/s write cap. OCP p16 vs pp32/35 payload-rate discrepancy remains unresolved.

host_read_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Grade-2 interface payload budget: 16 channels * x64 * 16 GT/s / 8 * 75% = 1536 GB/s per direction. Program latency separately limits media writes; no extra 16 GB/s write cap. OCP p16 vs pp32/35 payload-rate discrepancy remains unresolved.

host_write_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Grade-2 interface payload budget: 16 channels * x64 * 16 GT/s / 8 * 75% = 1536 GB/s per direction. Program latency separately limits media writes; no extra 16 GB/s write cap. OCP p16 vs pp32/35 payload-rate discrepancy remains unresolved.

queue_scope.basis: Local research translation: divide upstream 4096 read-page credits/stack over 16 host channels, then use 256 combined read/write credits and a 64-write subset per host channel. Not upstream queue semantics or OCP-mandated values.

max_outstanding_requests.basis: Local research translation: divide upstream 4096 read-page credits/stack over 16 host channels, then use 256 combined read/write credits and a 64-write subset per host channel. Not upstream queue semantics or OCP-mandated values.

max_outstanding_write_requests.basis: Local research translation: divide upstream 4096 read-page credits/stack over 16 host channels, then use 256 combined read/write credits and a 64-write subset per host channel. Not upstream queue semantics or OCP-mandated values.

internal_bandwidth_gb_s.basis: Per-core-channel payload rate = upstream raw 101.25 GB/s * 4096 / (4096 + 224 OOB) = 96 GB/s. No separate OOB, ECC or TSV stage is reproduced; zero fixed front delay is a local simplification.

front_ns.basis: Per-core-channel payload rate = upstream raw 101.25 GB/s * 4096 / (4096 + 224 OOB) = 96 GB/s. No separate OOB, ECC or TSV stage is reproduced; zero fixed front delay is a local simplification.

assumptions: B200 and Qwen are controlled substitutions, not the paper Rubin/Llama workload.
Finite closed batch: no departure-driven refill, no disaggregated KV reception, no paper staging SRAM.
Short real execution; no forecast and no full-length detailed-reference rerun.
Paper-memory cases use generic page service with explicit research controls; not OCP/GC parity with scan cases.
throughput_scope: finite closed-batch decode window after first visible token; not continuous steady-state TPS
